rv.q: This performance is exciting, inventive, and inspiring.

Six years on, it’s an intriguing piece to remount. Its wholesome, jolly hockey sticks storyline lacks the sparkle, bawdy humour and lurid appeal of her best works. What’s more, it’s layered with a pick ‘n’ mix assortment of songs – spanning jazz, country, gospel and more – that often sit awkwardly on top of the drama.
